cases.name: base
cases.scriptSource:
local utils = require("mp.utils")
assert(mp.set_property("target-prim", "bt.2020"))
assert(mp.set_property("target-trc", "linear"))
assert(mp.set_property("target-peak", "418"))
assert(mp.set_property("hdr-compute-peak", "no"))
assert(mp.set_property("gamut-mapping-mode", "clip"))
assert(mp.set_property("background", "color"))
assert(mp.set_property("background-color", "#000000"))
assert(mp.set_property("video-aspect-override", "4:3"))
assert(mp.set_property("sub-visibility", "yes"))
local overlay = nil
mp.register_event("file-loaded", function()
  local selected = false
  for _, track in ipairs(mp.get_property_native("track-list")) do
    if track.type == "sub" and track.selected then selected = true end
  end
  assert(selected == false)
  local file = assert(io.open("F:/project/3/kisaki/node_modules/.cache/libmpv-design/composition/base.ready.json", "w"))
  file:write(utils.format_json({ ready = true, subtitleSelected = selected, osdConfigured = overlay ~= nil,
    targetTrc = mp.get_property("target-trc"), targetPrim = mp.get_property("target-prim"),
    blendSubtitles = mp.get_property("blend-subtitles") }))
  file:close()
end)
local file_options = { ["sub-auto"] = "no" }
assert(mp.command_native({"loadfile", "F:/project/3/kisaki/node_modules/.cache/libmpv-design/tonemapping/steps-pq-4000.mkv", "replace", -1, file_options}))
